O1.statement: A connection is put back into the pool with Put, and afterwards Release is called; Release closes that idle connection.
O1.fragment: Release all connections in the connection pool

O2.statement: The pool is full and a Get waits; afterwards a Put returns a connection and the waiting Get receives it.
O2.fragment: When the connection pool is full, support for connection waiting

O3.statement: A connection stays idle longer than the maximum idle time and afterwards a Get takes it; the pool closes and discards it instead of returning it.
O3.fragment: the timeout connection will be closed and discarded

O4.statement: A Get is waiting because the pool is full, and afterwards Release is called; the waiting Get then returns.
O4.fragment: Release all connections in the connection pool

O5.statement: Release is called, and afterwards Put is called with a connection that was obtained before Release; the connection is closed.
O5.fragment: Release all connections in the connection pool
